plugins.name: cardan
plugins.description: The shared Claude Code setup of the Cardan Nuxt projects: the frontend guidelines, the local review before every commit (the reviewer agents and their hook), release and PR skills, a Playwright MCP server for browser checks, Nuxt's documentation MCP server, and a cross-browser check in Chrome, Firefox and WebKit for the review round.

plugins.name: cardan-browsers
plugins.description: Playwright MCP servers for Firefox and WebKit, off by default: switch it on with /plugin to look into a difference the cross-browser check found.
